title: [Subcontracting] Bug 641241: Notify to install Subcontracting app in Subcontracting Worksheet
summary: A notification now prompts users on SaaS to install the Subcontracting app when they access the obsolete Subcontracting Worksheet page, with options to install or dismiss the message.
key_points: SaaS-only notification guides users to install the Subcontracting replacement app
Appears when opening the obsolete Subcontracting Worksheet page if the app is not already installed
Notification respects user preferences through the My Notifications framework
Logic implemented in Manufacturing Setup Notif codeunit, called from page OnOpenPage event
All new code is wrapped in conditional compilation for the obsolete page's lifecycle
